execution.failure_control: Stop; ensure rollback of the same read-only transaction if its connection remains available. Do not open a new transaction or resubmit the file.

read_scope: Exact Cycle12 row and Dispatch38-46 metadata/digests.
Exactly one CH-passport/DE-destination method-scoped subject and derived native claim identities.

At most five matching execution starts, six queue operations and eight Intake metadata rows returned. A ninth Intake row is inspected only as an overflow sentinel; overflow returns a small STOP object without payload.
Current result-head/verification reference and at most eight linked archived original hashes/sizes.
Prior Owner receipts only aggregate count and ordered digest; no actor/session/receipt body output.
Required and explicitly optional catalog function/relation/authority metadata; no invocation of mutating helpers.
Installed v4 baseline, pinned read-only catalog comparison and a fresh natural BG1/Cron proof.
allowed_application_invocations: official_v3_guard_private.catalog_status_v1() with full native definition/owner/ACL/config binding checked before invocation
forbidden: HTTP or source action, Scheduler tick, Publisher, Queue/CAS mutation, audit invocation or Owner action.
Roles, grants, SET ROLE, ACL, secrets, authentication, login/2FA or passkey change.
Sequence nextval/setval/reset or HTTP allocator removal.
Reading original source bodies, auth sessions, actor details, signing keys, lease tokens, credential token hashes or raw native authority objects.
stop_rules: Any SQL error, unrecognized object/type/result form, missing mandatory object, timeout, unclear or truncated response.
Any stale/missing natural BG1 proof or changed v4/catalog/scheduler binding.
Terminal Cycle12 or Dispatch38-46 mismatch, active cycle or changed current publication state.
read_bounds_ok is not true or required_function_metadata_present is not true.
Any correlation/archive/shape condition in 02-RESULT-CONTRACT.json fails; no automatic rebind, retry or extra read.
phase_after_success: Evaluate only. The observation does not authorize CAS closure, a new Owner receipt, production rehearsal, installation or restart. Produce a newly bound write package after separate native validation and review.
restart_policy: Closure, CAS and Owner closure receipt alone must leave a default-closed dispatch gate. A separate one-cycle restart authorization is required before any new natural cycle or HTTP start.
at_package_interlock: If AT or another package changes BG1/functions first, this immutable read must stop. Rebinding requires a new package, new hashes and new Go; do not silently adopt the new catalog.
hash_convention: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8/LF file bytes. Manifest does not hash itself or files that contain its SHA; GO-SCOPE and report cite the finalized manifest. SHA256SUMS is an external checksum list and excludes itself.
